items.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2
items.summary: This second installment reviews 13 more Amazon SageMaker AI inference launches from 2026, spanning configuration recommendations, fitting more models onto each GPU, serving models too large for one instance, cross-Region routing, and post-launch tuning, bringing the year's total to 26.
items.creator: Aryaman Kothari

items.title: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Kimi Code CLI v2.7.0 adds a native Amazon Bedrock provider, so you can connect the open source coding agent to models like Kimi K3.1 Pro using your standard AWS credential chain (named profiles or SSO) instead of a separate API key. This post shows how to configure the provider and send your first request.
items.creator: Alex Thewsey
